{{Term/Store|Swim Up Waterfalls||Series, BotW, TotK}} is a recurring hidden [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280|edition= Expanded Edition|year= 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page=402-403}}</ref>

==Overview==
Swim Up Waterfalls is an [[Added Effect]] found on the [[Zora Armor]] that allows [[Link]] to climb up [[Waterfall]]s by pressing A when [[Swimming]] near their base. Upon reaching the top of the Waterfall, Link will launch up into the air and automatically open the [[Paraglider]].

==={{BotW|-}}===
When A is pressed to begin climbing a [[Waterfall]] in {{BotW}}, Link will dash to a set point at the base of the Waterfall and begin [[Swimming]] straight up. During the climb, [[Link]] will be unable to move sideways nor end the climb early, except by unequipping the [[Zora Armor]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
In {{TotK}}, [[Link]] can begin climbing a [[Waterfall]] from anywhere at its base, or from midair by moving through it while wearing the [[Zora Armor]]. He also now has the ability to freely strafe sideways while [[Swimming]] up a Waterfall, and he can jump backwards out of the Waterfall at any time. If Link has not obtained the [[Paraglider]], then he will begin falling straight down after launching above the Waterfall.

Link can use Swim Up Waterfalls to exit the [[Ancient Zora Waterworks]] and [[Lake Hylia Whirlpool Cave]] via the Waterfall at their entrances. When doing so, there will be a short fade to black, followed by Link launching abnormally high above the [[Whirlpool]]s.

Link's [[Stamina]] will immediately begin regenerating as soon as he starts swimming up a Waterfall, which was not the case in {{BotW|-}}.
